## tmh learners remind

Remind a learner

### Synopsis

Emails the learner a reminder: the invite again if they haven't started, or a nudge to finish if they have.

Scopes: learners:write

```
tmh learners remind <learnerId> [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --course-id string   The course. Defaults to the organization's default course.
  -h, --help               help for remind
```
